patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,2 +1,32 @@
-def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
-    pass
+def recite(start: int, take: int = 1) -> list[str]:
+    result = []
+    
+    for i in range(start, start - take, -1):
+        if i > 1:
+            current_bottles = f"{i} bottles"
+            next_bottles = f"{i-1} bottle" if i-1 == 1 else f"{i-1} bottles"
+            take_verb = "one"
+        elif i == 1:
+            current_bottles = "1 bottle"
+            next_bottles = "no more bottles"
+            take_verb = "it"
+        else:  # i == 0
+            result.append("No more bottles of beer on the wall, no more bottles of beer.")
+            result.append("Go to the store and buy some more, 99 bottles of beer on the wall.")
+            continue
+            
+        result.append(f"{current_bottles.capitalize()} of beer on the wall, {current_bottles} of beer.")
+        result.append(f"Take {take_verb} down and pass it around, {next_bottles} of beer on the wall.")
+    
+    # Add empty line between verses except for the last verse
+    final_result = []
+    verse_count = take
+    lines_per_verse = 2
+    
+    for i in range(len(result)):
+        final_result.append(result[i])
+        # Add empty line after every 2 lines except at the very end
+        if (i + 1) % 2 == 0 and (i + 1) < len(result):
+            final_result.append("")
+    
+    return final_result
